configuration.latent_model: f=sf*(sqrt(q)*u+sqrt(1-q)*v); r=sr*(a*u+sqrt(1-a^2)*w); u,v,w independent unit-variance Matern-5/2 GPs
configuration.sharing: a=tanh(raw_correlation); all shared output covariance is zero when a=0
configuration.scales: sf=exp(log_scale); sr=exp(log_margin_scale), absolute RSS standard deviation
configuration.prior_loading_scope: functional-scenario scalars; spatial differences through historical embedding, separate latent length scales and conditional posteriors
configuration.zero_sharing_check: set a=0 in target and raw kernels; source cross-output blocks also vanish; fixed remaining parameters reproduce collision-only conditioning
configuration.online_initialization: fixed learned base each round; raw component starts at fixed defaults
configuration.online_gradient_clipping: norm 5 separately for (margin_mean,log_margin_scale) and the other trainable parameters; original model retains its original single group
configuration.offline_scope: all eight original historical ADS archives per scenario; two stages trained from scratch, final checkpoints, no target or development responses
configuration.source_views: exact full-method view_record_ids from the original per-scenario snapshot
configuration.source_weights: global, query-before-feedback collision likelihood only; E1 not combined
configuration.controls: reuse archived original full-method and target-collision-only runs; training/model differences make this a workflow comparison
configuration.conditional_diagnostic: at each paid prefix hold parameters, source snapshot and weights fixed; compare p(U|Y,R) with p(U|Y) for the same new model; unqueried truth enters evaluation only
configuration.resource_basis: archived per-scenario training took 20,200-21,300 s and up to about 5 GiB CPU; allow three-kernel construction overhead without reducing training steps
configuration.expected_checks: independent latent covariance, PSD, source contraction, zero-sharing conditioning and optimizer isolation, dense/block agreement, six online scalars, strict typed checkpoints, batch invariant selection and future-feedback isolation

targeted_repair.result: zero-loading optimization and all 41 related checks passed

six online scalars and frozen offline structure

report_export_check.checked_fields: finite exported values; point correlation=sqrt(q)*a; RSS shared variance fraction=a^2
report_export_check.effect_conclusion: complete workflow comparison: failures +87, mean discovery AUC +1.361875; conditional RSS benefit unsupported
report_export_check.reporting_change: added predeclared equal-budget and matched-count distance summaries, conditional RSS directions and figure QA; replay source and observations unchanged

report_direction_rule: Candidate: neither failures nor AUC decreases and at least one improves; tradeoff: one improves while the other decreases; otherwise no discovery benefit. Final adoption also considers task-level scope and registered cost.
